text: `Sparkline startLabel` and `endLabel` print the first and last periods under the line's two ends ("2014-15" … "2025-26"), and `markLast` puts a dot on the latest point. A trend line in a dashboard tile has no axis, so without them a ten-year line could not be told from a ten-month one, and the sentence beside it could not be tied to a point. Sparklines that set none of these are unchanged.
